Frequently Asked Questions — Owner Builders in Government & Councils, Central Coast

Do owner builders need a licence to hire an excavator?

In NSW, excavators under 3 tonnes do not require a formal licence. Our 0.8T, 1T, and 1.7T mini excavators are all under 3 tonnes and can be operated by owner builders without a licence.

Is it easy for owner builders to operate a mini excavator?

Yes. Mini excavators are relatively straightforward to operate. BuildHire provides full operating instructions with every hire, and our team is available by phone to answer questions.

How much does it cost for an owner builder to hire a mini excavator?

Mini excavator hire starts from $200/day for the 0.8T. Delivery and collection is $110. All prices include GST. This is significantly cheaper than wet hire with an operator.

Does BuildHire work with local councils and government contractors?

Yes. BuildHire supplies equipment to local councils and government contractors across NSW. We can provide invoices, insurance certificates, and compliance documentation as required.

Does BuildHire deliver to Central Coast for government & councils projects?

Yes. BuildHire delivers to Central Coast and the wider Central Coast region. Book before 12pm for next-day delivery to Central Coast government & councils sites.
